decisions.reason: Validation and technical judgment within existing goals may proceed using the documented tools and evidence; no new value or permission is implied.
Technical lesson adoption or revocation within the existing authorized role-learning scope is a technical lifecycle action, not a universal new approval gate.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and is not authorized by the existing adapter or proposal.

remaining: Run a bounded controlled comparison of memory conditions with fixed tasks and record whether retrieved lessons change behavior, including adverse or irrelevant retrieval.
Measure end-to-end model/token cost and human review time before claiming efficiency or time savings.
Validate expertise discovery and cross-agent routing, including wrong expert, stale knowledge, conflicts, cycles, and revocation, before claiming routing works.
Do not publish private role memory beyond its authorized scope absent an explicit human permission decision.
